title: TVSM Dev Links
description: Machine-local developer overlay stored at {modWorkDir}/dev-links.json. Registers live build output paths that bypass the store and staging for fast iteration. Never included in snapshots or rollback.

links.description: Map of mod name to dev link entry.

src.description: Absolute path to the build output directory. Resolved from --src at link time; stored as absolute to eliminate CWD ambiguity at apply time.

installLayout.description: How tvsm mod apply materialises this dev link. Defaults to plugins-dll. bepinex-root is not valid for dev links.

linkedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the link was registered.

note.description: Optional freeform annotation shown in tvsm mod dev list.
